The card asks after which insect the spirit-level vial is 'named', but the naming ran the other way or from a common root: DWDS derives the insect's name (zool. Latin Libellula) from libella '(small) level', and Rondelet (1558) named the insect by comparison with an architect's instrument. The question now asks which insect shares the vial's German name; the card's words stay in cardText.
